guards.description: Pi Runtime must not depend on Node Agent implementation.
Pi Runtime must not gain shell, Docker socket, or Docker client capabilities.
Node Agent is an observation plane and must not depend on Pi Runtime/reasoner implementations.
Pi-Ops control plane must not import Pi Runtime coordinator/specialist implementation modules.
